info.title: host/authority/v1/work_context.proto
info.description:
Moved from codefly-dev/core proto/codefly/base/v0/work_context.proto on 2026-10-21.
Every message, field name and field number is unchanged, so the deterministic
bytes a verifier reads are identical; only the package and the Go import path
differ. The conformance fixtures prove it. A change in meaning is a V2 message
beside the V1, never a field reinterpreted.
